# Security Policy

The latest code on the default branch is the supported version.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue for a security problem.

Report it privately at https://github.com/samyyy2311/CassetteCat-Desktop/security/advisories/new. Include clear steps to reproduce the issue and avoid sharing private data.

## What happens next

The maintainer will review the report, confirm the impact, and work on a fix. Please give the project time to release the fix before sharing details publicly.
